verdict.rationale: Capacities documents that AI features are fully opt-in and no space data is shared with third-party AI services unless activated, which reflects a privacy-conscious posture, but there is no explicit mention of a general telemetry/usage-analytics opt-out setting distinct from AI data sharing. Missing for 10: a documented telemetry/analytics toggle or privacy settings page explicitly covering non-AI usage tracking, and independent confirmation of the opt-out working.
